completion_rule: DONE_VERIFIED requires persisted implementation plus required tests/readback; prompt execution alone is insufficient

cards.title: Master Production Bootstrap
cards.acceptance: python run.py performs a real persisted state action and smoke test passes

cards.title: Project State System
cards.acceptance: project CLI create/status/next and unit tests pass

cards.title: Local Memory
cards.acceptance: SQLite store/search/update/invalidate/trace operations pass tests

cards.title: Source Evidence Layer
cards.acceptance: unverified inference cannot be emitted as VERIFIED_FACT

cards.title: AI Provider Abstraction
cards.acceptance: provider interface plus mock provider runs without paid API

cards.title: Agent Executor
cards.acceptance: bounded demo agent completes integration test with logs/state

cards.title: Business Core
cards.acceptance: client request can produce persisted estimate/quote without invented prices

cards.title: Business Research
cards.acceptance: research outputs sources/claims/comparison/conclusions with provenance and freshness

cards.title: Book Production Core
cards.acceptance: book state machine blocks FINAL until continuity gate passes

cards.title: Continuity Checker
cards.acceptance: known continuity fixtures yield severity-tagged evidence pairs

cards.title: Multi-Model Review
cards.acceptance: independent critics remain isolated until aggregation

cards.title: Test Benchmark Engine
cards.acceptance: baseline/candidate/delta PASS-FAIL runner rejects critical regression

cards.title: Change Control
cards.acceptance: patch lifecycle records tests/benchmark/decision and supports rollback

cards.title: File Ingestion
cards.acceptance: supported inputs are hashed, represented and deduplicated

cards.title: Personal Knowledge Search
cards.acceptance: ask command retrieves project/docs/decisions/state with source separation

cards.title: Daily Control Panel
cards.acceptance: today command reports real stored projects/tasks/failures only

cards.title: Backup Recovery
cards.acceptance: backup and checksum-verified restore pass fixture

cards.title: Security
cards.acceptance: secret leakage/path traversal/destructive-tool security tests pass

cards.title: Cost Control
cards.acceptance: API usage is attributable by provider/model/project/task and budget limits work

cards.title: Local Cloud Router
cards.acceptance: routing decisions are logged and policy tests select expected provider tier

cards.title: Production Gate
cards.acceptance: PRODUCTION_READINESS.md reports gates without claiming ready when FATAL/MAJOR exists

cards.title: First Real Business Run
cards.acceptance: one real pilot records automation/human steps/errors/cost/time and persisted outputs

cards.title: First Real Book Run
cards.acceptance: one existing book is ingested and continuity issue report generated without wholesale rewrite

cards.title: Failure Analysis
cards.acceptance: real failures are ranked by root cause/frequency/damage/fix/test

cards.title: V0.1 Release
cards.acceptance: release artifacts exist, critical tests pass, benchmark frozen, tag created

notes: No card allocates a new global Self-Improvement SI id by itself.
Human/market/provider evidence must remain real and provenance-backed; it cannot be simulated for gate passage.
